mapper.select: SELECT validation_run_id AS validationRunId, validation_month AS validationMonth, run_no AS runNo, run_type AS runType, status, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, finalized_at AS finalizedAt, triggered_by AS triggeredBy, finalized_by AS finalizedBy, failure_message AS failureMessage, created_at AS createdAt FROM fgc.validation_run WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}
